scope: Read-only source contract review for the accepted Manager API candidate; no provider, API, POST, UI, env-secret, or R3A-candidate calls.

facts.claim: The route prefix is /api/v4/manager/research. GET /workspace accepts date and view; the browser client sends GET /api/v4/manager/research/workspace?date=<YYYYMMDD>&view=dynamic and does not accept a research_cutoff or market_session_date query. plan_context derives research_cutoff from server now.

Existing Manager HK Connect read_scope calls read_universe_evidence(root, plan_trade_date), then requires source_date == plan_trade_date, market == HK_CONNECT, and observed_at <= research_cutoff. The pinned file SHA matches the provided b6c...a6248 baseline. This code does not check a separate persisted publication available_at.

plan_context validates plan_trade_date against the HK securities calendar and uses the last completed HK securities session before the plan date as market_session. For plan_trade_date=20260930 at tonight's cutoff, that market_session is 20260929; neither date nor cutoff is caller-overridable through the workspace GET.

The local 2026 calendar resolves 20260930 as open for A, HK securities, and Southbound Connect; 20261001 as closed; 20261002 as HK securities open but A and Southbound Connect closed; 20261008 is the next date when both A and HK securities are open, so Southbound Connect reopens. Stage-center's HK observation lane follows HK securities state, which must not be called Southbound eligibility.

The announcement refresh is POST /api/v4/manager/research/announcements/refresh?date=<YYYYMMDD> with an empty request body; a non-whitespace body is rejected. Defaults are resume=false and source_scope absent (HKEX path). It captures a bounded issuer batch and records incomplete directory exhaustion; it is not the R3A membership publisher or US data producer. POST /workspace/refresh only projects existing inputs.

GET /api/v4/manager/research/announcements?date=<YYYYMMDD> reprojects only documents whose publication and acquisition are within the current consumer cutoff. It retains the original query_cutoff and marks a later consumer cutoff as SOURCE_QUERY_CUTOFF_PRECEDES_CURRENT_PLAN_CUTOFF; the route does not backdate.

The workspace GET reads the existing US exact-session peripheral store; it does not fetch/materialize US data. The chosen US session is latest_completed_session(research_cutoff), and a valid snapshot must be POST_CLOSE, exact-session, lineage-verified, and captured_at <= research_cutoff. At 2026-09-30 21:39 HKT the 20260930 NY session is in progress, so expected_us_session remains 20260929; after its close (2026-10-01 04:00 HKT), a later GET can expect 20260930 only if that exact owner artifact is published and valid.

US-to-HK mapping is a separate relation-layer result: require the exact US input to be mapping_eligible, cutoff-bound issuer material, and an accepted structured relation. Raw positive US movers or a bridge status alone do not prove a mapping.

Late-tail evidence is admitted only with exact symbol, provider/stage, source_trade_date == market_session, matching plan_trade_date, OBSERVATION_ONLY status, and observed_at <= available_at <= research_cutoff. Per the parent-provided prior audit, the historical 20260930 tail's 20 raw rows were not candidates; they remain CANNOT_CONFIRM and were not reread here.
evidence_paths: Parent-provided boundary: historical 20260930 late-tail audit (not re-opened)

Before any claim, bind its capture_run_id, artifact SHA, actual acquisition completion time, and persisted publication available_at from the new owner receipt; require both times <= the Manager GET's server-generated research_cutoff.

For a same-date, current research preview only, use the exact Manager target date 20260930 with view=dynamic after R3A publication. Confirm read_scope reports the source date 20260930 and target-date authority only; this is not an as-of-09:35 replay and does not prove next-session reuse.

If a fresh official-announcement scan is needed, the existing route is POST /api/v4/manager/research/announcements/refresh?date=20260930, with no body at all (not {}). Default resume=false/source_scope absent selects the HKEX path. This POST is not an R3A or US refresh and was not called.

Read announcements with GET /api/v4/manager/research/announcements?date=20260930. Check exact target date, product/run/hash, original query_cutoff, per-document published_at and acquired/retrieved time, and current consumer_cutoff. Accept a bounded PARTIAL result as partial only; do not claim directory exhaustion or first-publication proof.

Read the original workspace with GET /api/v4/manager/research/workspace?date=20260930&view=dynamic. Compare plan_context.research_cutoff with R3A acquired_at and available_at, inspect market_session (20260929 for tonight's 0930 target), announcement_observation times, and US owner_chain lineage.

At tonight's cutoff, expect the latest completed NY session to be 20260929. To verify US session 20260930, wait until after the 20260930 NYSE close (2026-10-01 04:00 HKT) and after the existing US owner has published its exact-session payload/receipt/manifest; then GET dynamic workspace again. Do not supply a hand-set market_session_date or cutoff.

For a real two-source mapping, require us_market_attention.expected_us_session to match the completed session, mapping_eligible=true, verified source identity, captured_at <= research_cutoff, and research_attention.us_mapping_diagnostics.status=COMPUTED_BY_RELATION_LAYER with relation_gate=TWO_SOURCE_PIT_VERIFIED_REQUIRED and accepted_hk_mapping_count > 0. Otherwise report CANNOT_CONFIRM, even if raw US movers are present.

Do not treat 20261002 as a Southbound Connect consumer date: only HK securities are open. The next actual Connect session is 20261008, whose preceding Connect session is 20260930; however the accepted current read_scope requires source_date == plan_trade_date (20261008), so today's 20260930 capture cannot be claimed as consumed for 20261008 under this API contract.
